# PRF001 `loop-not-vectorized`

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

gfortran could not vectorise a loop (`-fopt-info-vec-missed`).

## Why

A loop the compiler could not vectorise runs one element per instruction. The reason the compiler gives
(a dependence, a non-contiguous access, a call it cannot inline) is reported with the finding. Many
loops are not worth vectorising: this rule is informational and off by default; select it when tuning
a hot spot. Reported only with `fobis lint --compiler-feedback LOG` (see the linting guide).

## Reported

```fortran
do i = 2, n
  y(i) = y(i) * y(i-1)      ! gfortran: missed: couldn't vectorize loop
end do
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[PRF001] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = PRF001` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
